tools.name: create_custom_game
tools.title: Save a custom game
tools.description: Saves a supplied self-contained HTML game as a free private draft. Returns a preview URL and private management token. Accepted games have inline code and embedded assets, keyboard and touch controls, a goal and restart. Network requests, payments and personal-data collection are prohibited. Repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the existing draft.

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML game with inline CSS/JS and embedded assets. External dependencies, fetches, forms, popups, payments and personal-data collection are prohibited. Supported controls are canvas or DOM with keyboard and touch input. The game includes restart and clear win/lose states. Completion notification is parent.postMessage({type:'playablegift:complete'}, '*').

tools.name: export_gift
tools.title: Export a draft
tools.description: Returns a private draft as portable JSON containing its complete self-contained game HTML. The recipient's email address and private tokens are excluded. An optional revision number selects a retained revision instead of the current version.

revision.description: A retained revision number. The default is the current revision.

tools.name: get_gift
tools.title: Read a draft
tools.description: Returns a private draft's metadata, current revision, preview link and status for the supplied management token. Game HTML is excluded.

tools.name: get_gift_catalog
tools.title: Read custom game rules
tools.description: Returns the supported formats, capabilities, requirements and limits for saving custom HTML games as private drafts.

tools.name: get_gift_history
tools.title: Read draft history
tools.description: Returns the last five retained revisions of a private draft for the supplied management token. Revision metadata may contain the sender's personal content. Game HTML is excluded.

tools.name: get_made_game
tools.title: Check game progress
tools.description: Returns the current stage of a game generation job identified by its private idempotency key. A completed job includes the title, cast, recipient play link and sender management link. Management links grant private sender access.

tools.name: make_game
tools.title: Make a game
tools.description: Starts generation of a small browser game about one person from the sender's supplied habits or inside jokes. Returns immediately with build progress. Games are free within a daily allowance. When the assistant allowance runs out, returns an OAuth sign-in request or a handoff URL. It never charges anyone or sends messages.

brief.description: The sender's supplied details about the recipient, including two or three specific habits, catchphrases or inside jokes.

from.description: The sender's name, shown in the game. Optional.

idempotencyKey.description: Private request identifier containing 64 random lowercase hex characters.

tools.name: revise_custom_game
tools.title: Revise a custom game
tools.description: Replaces an existing private draft with supplied HTML and game details. Requires the draft's management token and current revision number. A stale expectedRevision is rejected to prevent overwriting another edit.

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML game with inline CSS/JS and embedded assets. External dependencies, fetches, forms, popups, payments and personal-data collection are prohibited. Supported controls are canvas or DOM with keyboard and touch input. The game includes restart and clear win/lose states. Completion notification is parent.postMessage({type:'playablegift:complete'}, '*').

resources.name: gift-guide
resources.description: How to make a Playable Gift through an AI assistant, and how to share it safely.
